# Portstrike rules
TSFMC Halcyon and PDV Helios are considered "under the Portstrike treaty", in other words, players cannot attempt to attack ships (or the base itself) who were not in direct combat 2 minutes ago, within 264 meters, unless either of them declare war on eachother; to declare war on each other, there's 3 checkpoints you have to check; Shift time is 1:25 or more
There is considerable in-character tension between PDV and TSF majority of either faction agrees.
After they declare war, neither Halcyon nor Helios are considered under Portstrike treaty, and instead now you can attack the base freely.
(Note: this also applies to vizier & colonel equipment, unless a faction character deliberately moves it out of their respective bases.)
